evan_sales: Quick heads-up: large regulated fintech wants a 6-week on-prem POC in a physically isolated colo (no outbound). They listed: delta-only minibundles via USB, HSM-based customer key import, explicit patch cadence in the SOW. Need pricing, a short ops runbook we can hand them, and questionnaire answers.

marie_sre: We can support that setup. Two caveats: (1) minibundles must be signed and chunked for resumable USB transfers, (2) large LLM cold starts without a prefix snapshot will spike cost/latency. We'll document a warmup snapshot flow.

ev an_sales: @marie_sre (tiny typo in your handle earlier) 49b can you draft a 1-2 page runbook with exact commands we can drop into their security review? They want verifiable steps.

nguyen_se: Minimal offline runbook (commands):
1) Verify manifest/hash and signature:
```
$ redwood-offline verify --manifest manifest.json
manifest: ok
bundle-0006.tar: signature ok (key-id: CLIENT-HSM-01)
checksums: ok
```
2) Apply bundle offline:
```
$ redwood-offline apply --bundle bundle-0006.tar --atomic
Apply started: bundle-0006.tar
Progress: 12% ... 100%
Apply complete.
```
3) Import key (if customer provides wrapped blob):
```
$ pkcs11-tool --login --write-object wrapped-key.blob --label RW_KEY
```
Note: we provide a verification utility that runs entirely offline and returns deterministic exit codes.

tara_ps: Pricing suggestion for POC: one-time POC engineering/support fee $9,500 (includes packaging + eng on-call), up to 6 minibundles included. Extra minibundles: $750 each. Emergency hotfixes after POC: $1,200 per hotfix. Optional offline SLA (24/7 phone + 4hr security patch path): $4,500/month during POC.

ev an_sales: They dislike per-bundle surprises. Please prepare a capped quote: POC fee + up to 6 minibundles included, then per-bundle overage. Also include optional SLA line item.

ashley_security: Security questionnaire notes they can paste: 
- Image signing: Supported. We ship signed manifests and SBOMs for every minibundle.
- Telemetry: Disabled by default in private/offline installs; any telemetry requires explicit opt-in and signed consent from customer ops.
- Key mgmt: We accept PKCS#11-based HSM integration or wrapped-import blobs. We never ship private key material.
- Compliance: SOC2 Type II summary + runtime attestation are available under NDA.
I'll drop concise copy snippets in the shared doc for them to paste into the questionnaire.

marie_sre: Recommended upgrade cadence for POC: monthly minibundle cadence with a documented emergency one-off hotfix path for critical CVEs. For production deployments, recommend quarterly minibundles aligned with scheduled maintenance windows. If they need weekly changes, advise moving to a Dedicated deployment or allow limited egress for automated deltas.

ev an_sales: Action items: @tara_ps prepare capped quote (POC + up to 6 minibundles + SLA optional), @marie_sre and @nguyen_se assemble the 2-page runbook and sample commands, @ashley_security produce questionnaire snippets. I'll present this to the CTO tomorrow EOD.

deploy-bot: Deployment ticket created -> #SW-29821 (poc-offline-bundles) assigned to nguyen_se, due 2026-05-12.

ev an_sales: Thanks team :thumbsup:
